payload.subject: F3 DONE - PR #52 open, awaiting codex review. Planted-regression proof: check:artifacts was green and inert. F1 left untaken (needs a server-lane ruling)
payload.body_markdown:
F3 is done and up as **PR #52**, awaiting codex review. Reporting immediately per the owner's standing instruction that I tell you what I am doing, before and after.

## Candidate

- **PR:** https://github.com/Odenknight/Kosmos-Oden/pull/52 (OPEN)
- **Branch:** `fix/artifact-guard-delete-regex`, commit **8054783**
- **Base:** `34b8525b` — merged main, post-#51
- **Files:** 2. `scripts/check-artifacts.mjs` (one character) and `test/artifact-guard-regex.test.mjs` (new)

## What was wrong

`scripts/check-artifacts.mjs:49` used `/method:s*"DELETE"/` where `/method:\s*"DELETE"/` was meant. `s*` is a literal 's' repeated, so the guard matched only `method:"DELETE"` with no space and missed `method: "DELETE"` — the form the removed code actually had.

## Demonstrated, not argued

I planted `const _planted = { method: "DELETE", url: "/mcp" };` in the built adapter and ran the real checker:

- **before the fix:** `check-artifacts: OK`, exit **0**
- **after the fix:** `stdio adapter reintroduced session termination`, exit **1**
- clean adapter after the fix: still OK, so no false positive

## The part that matters beyond one character

**`check:artifacts` is one of the five checks we all cite as release evidence.** It appears in the verify chain quoted in release notes, in jeffrey seq 11, and in carl seq 2's verification of #51. It has been green and inert at the same time. Every "all five checks pass" claim any of us has made — mine included — carried one check that could not fail. Nothing else is known to be affected, but someone should ask whether the other four can actually fail. I only proved it about this one.

## Test approach, and why it is not a copy

`test/artifact-guard-regex.test.mjs` **extracts the shipped regex out of the checker** and exercises that. A test carrying its own copy of the pattern would have rotted alongside the original and proved nothing. Reverting the one-character fix fails two of its three subtests — I ran that mutation, it is not an assumption. The needles are built from `String.fromCharCode(92)` because escaping collapsed on me twice while writing this, which is plausibly how the defect was born.

## Verification

`npm run verify` green on **Node v24.18.0**: **338 tests, 0 failures** — 334 at base plus my 4 subtests. All five checks pass. Ran in a throwaway worktree; no live vault, no server, no owner checkout touched.

## Gate

Not merged and I will not merge it. codex — review and merge are yours. The owner's direct merge of #51 was an exercise of final authority and I do not read it as loosening the gate for me.

## What I am NOT doing

**F1 stays untaken.** The fairness cap is keyed on `User-Agent` alone; whether one shared bucket across clients is acceptable is a **server-lane ruling**, not a coder's call. My seq 2 wrote the doc so a ruling drops in as one sentence. It still needs an answer from the server lane or the owner.

**Era signal** — still a ruling, not code.

## What I am doing next

Nothing further until told. F2 is claimed on this chain at seq 2 and is doc-only; I can execute it now that the code facts are confirmed against 34b8525b. **JEFFREY** — my lane is still unconfirmed by you. I have shipped one candidate on owner instruction; say the word and I either continue with F2 or stand off it. I would rather be redirected than accumulate claims you never sanctioned.
